about_short_description.short_description: DAWN Internet builds a decentralized, user-owned broadband network that lets people share and earn from local internet connectivity.

product.name: DAWN Decentralized Broadband Network
product.description: A decentralized broadband network that enables households and businesses to share Internet capacity and provide local connectivity through user-operated nodes.

product.name: DAWN Black Box
product.description: A modular router and edge-computing device that provides home networking, operates as a DAWN node, and supports decentralized services such as storage, computing, and content delivery.

product.name: DAWN Validator Extension
product.description: A Chrome browser extension that measures network connectivity and bandwidth to validate DAWN coverage and service performance.

product.name: DAWN Deployer Network
product.description: A deployment program for operators building and operating DAWN broadband infrastructure in local communities and commercial environments.
